source: Benigni/Bossa rulebase for mutagenicity and carcinogenicity (a module of Toxtree)
citation: Benigni, R.; Bossa, C.; Jeliazkova, N. G.; Netzeva, T. I.; Worth, A. P. The Benigni/Bossa rulebase for mutagenicity and carcinogenicity - a module of Toxtree. JRC Technical Report EUR 23241 EN, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, 2008.
note: These 9 SMARTS strings are reproduced from Ferrari, T.; Gini, G. 'An open source multistep model to predict mutagenicity from statistical analysis and relevant structural alerts.' BMC Chemistry 2010, 4 (Suppl 1), S2, DOI 10.1186/1752-153X-4-S1-S2 (open access), Additional File 4 (the two subsets of Benigni/Bossa structural alerts that paper selected as most predictive on the Bursi/Hansen Ames benchmark) -- fetched directly from that paper's own supplementary-material file (13065_2010_260_MOESM4_ESM.pdf), not a third-party transcription. This is a SUBSET of the full Benigni/Bossa rulebase (~30 alerts total): only alerts with a directly machine-readable SMARTS string in that supplementary PDF are included here -- several real alerts in the source (e.g. SA_25 aromatic nitroso, SA_28bis aromatic amines, SA_29 aromatic diazo, SA_8 aliphatic halogens, SA_27 nitro-aromatic) are described in the source only as a structure diagram plus prose exclusion rules, not a SMARTS string, and are deliberately left out here rather than approximated/guessed. SA_18/SA_19 (polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, 3+ fused rings, non-heteroaromatic/heteroaromatic) ARE implemented -- see ring_fusion_alerts below -- but as real custom ring-perception code (scripts/compute_mutagenicity_alert_features.py's fused_aromatic_ring_systems), not a SMARTS string, since the source itself only gives a prose definition ('three or more fused rings') for these two, not a SMARTS -- this is a genuinely non-local/global topological property (which SMARTS substructure matching, and message-passing GNNs with limited depth, both have real difficulty expressing) rather than something we chose not to look for.

ring_fusion_alerts.title: Heterocyclic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (heteroaromatic, 3+ fused rings)
